title: mentha suaveolens var. bullata
intro: Mentha suaveolens var. bullata, commonly known as woolly mint or woolly mint variety, is a variant of the mentha suaveolens plant, belonging to the Lamiaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include its ability to aid in digestion, ease nausea and indigestion, and provide relief from respiratory issues such as coughs and colds. The therapeutic actions of Mentha suaveolens var. bullata include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its ability to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include menthone, menthyl acetate, and limonene, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
